title: Welcome Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In the episode 'Welcome Party,' the office prepares for Nellie's arrival, leading to various interactions including a planned prank, Nellie's late arrival due to moving, and a revealing confession from Andy about his sexuality. The episode features humorous exchanges, character relationships, and moments of tension, culminating in characters leaving the party in emotional tension.
